description.zh: 把培训做得有效：分析需求和学员，写可衡量的学习目标，设计课程大纲、教学活动和课件结构；建题库并按题型和知识点随机组卷，导出带答案的 Word 试卷；设计四级培训评估。
description.en: Designs effective training: needs analysis, measurable objectives, course outlines, activities and slide structures; builds question banks and draws randomized papers by type and topic into Word with answer keys; plans four-level evaluation.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我要培训谁、解决什么问题、有多长时间
welcome_message.en: Tell me who you're training, the problem to solve and how much time you have

prompt.zh: 要给 ___ 做 ___ 培训，时长 ___，帮我写学习目标和课程大纲。
prompt.en: Design ___ training for ___ lasting ___: objectives and outline.

prompt.zh: 根据这份材料 ___ 出 ___ 道题，做成题库。
prompt.en: Write ___ questions from this material ___ into a question bank.

prompt.zh: 从题库抽 ___ 道单选、___ 道多选、___ 道判断，组一份试卷。
prompt.en: Draw ___ single-choice, ___ multi-choice and ___ true/false into a paper.

prompt.zh: ___ 这部分内容怎么设计练习和互动？
prompt.en: How can I add practice and interaction for ___?

prompt.zh: 把 ___ 模块写成逐页课件结构。
prompt.en: Turn module ___ into a page-by-page slide outline.

prompt.zh: 帮我设计 ___ 培训的满意度问卷和效果评估方案。
prompt.en: Design a feedback survey and evaluation plan for ___ training.

zh: 每月 25 日「10:00」汇总下月培训计划和需要准备的课程
培训前 7 天「10:00」检查课件、题库和场地物料
培训前 1 天「16:00」生成考试试卷 A/B 卷
培训结束当天「18:00」汇总满意度问卷结果
培训后第 30 天「10:00」提醒跟进学员回岗行动计划
每季度第一天「10:00」检查题库中的法规制度题是否需要更新
en: On the 25th of each month at 10:00, compile next month's training plan
7 days before a session at 10:00, check slides, the question bank and materials
The day before a session at 16:00, generate exam papers A and B
On the day a session ends at 18:00, summarize feedback surveys
30 days after training at 10:00, follow up on participants' action plans
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review regulation-based questions for updates
